Evening Life Drawing with Sophia Shuvalova (1 x sessions)

Thu 01 Oct

|

Fishergate Room

Week 1 of a flexible six-week life course, drawing from professional models while developing skills in observation, anatomy, proportion, tone, composition and expressive mark-making, with all materials provided and expert tuition throughout

Time & Location

01 Oct 2026, 18:00 – 19:30

Fishergate Room, 7-15 Fye Bridge St, Norwich NR3 1LJ, UK

About the event

THURSDAY 1 OCTOBER | 6PM - 7.30PM


Please note this booking page is for one session only priced at £25. If you would like to book the full 6 week course, priced at £145, you can do so here.


Drawing from life remains one of the best ways to develop observation, confidence and technical skill as an artist.


Suitable for complete beginners and improvers alike, these life drawing classes provide the opportunity to draw from professional life models with all materials provided. Through a variety of short and long poses, you'll learn both traditional and contemporary approaches to drawing the human figure. Topics include gesture drawing, anatomy, proportion, tonal drawing, structure, composition and expressive mark-making. Guided exercises and demonstrations will help you strengthen your observational skills while developing your own creative approach to drawing.
